description:
Migrate `jmap-calendars-types` to consume the new `jmap-jscalendar-types` crate (created in child .1): add path-dep, re-export the 14 types so the public API stays byte-stable, and remove the now-redundant local `src/jscalendar.rs`.

## Mechanical steps

1. Add `jmap-jscalendar-types = { path = "../crate-jmap-jscalendar-types" }` to `crate-jmap-calendars-types/Cargo.toml` `[dependencies]`.

2. Remove `src/jscalendar.rs` from `crate-jmap-calendars-types/src/`. (Its content now lives in the new crate per child .1.)

3. Update `crate-jmap-calendars-types/src/lib.rs`:
   - Remove `pub mod jscalendar;` declaration.
   - Replace `pub use jscalendar::{ ... };` with `pub use jmap_jscalendar_types::{ ... };` — same imported names, new source.
   - If `lib.rs` previously had `pub use jscalendar` glob form, prefer the explicit list for clarity. Match the existing style if specific names were listed.

4. Update any other internal usage of `crate::jscalendar::*` paths within jmap-calendars-types (e.g. inside `calendar.rs`, `event.rs`, `notification.rs`) to use `jmap_jscalendar_types::*` or the re-exports from `crate::*` — whichever the existing style prefers.

5. Update `crate-jmap-calendars-types/PLAN.md`:
   - Remove or replace §1-§8 with a pointer: "JSCalendar typed sub-types live in `jmap-jscalendar-types`. See `crate-jmap-jscalendar-types/PLAN.md` for the hybrid-design rationale. This crate's `CalendarEvent` keeps its sloppy `Option<serde_json::Value>` fields as the wire-format anchor; consumers obtain typed views via `serde_json::from_value::<jmap_calendars_types::Location>(event.locations.unwrap())` (the re-export) or the equivalent `jmap_jscalendar_types::Location` direct path."

## Public API stability

The 14 type names previously imported as `jmap_calendars_types::Location` (etc.) MUST remain importable at that path after this child lands. This is enforced by the `pub use jmap_jscalendar_types::*;` (or explicit-list equivalent) in lib.rs.

The 14 type names should also be importable via `jmap_calendars_types::jscalendar::Location` if any consumer used that nested path — verify with a grep over downstream usage in this workspace before deciding whether to add `pub use jmap_jscalendar_types as jscalendar;` or just drop the nested path.

Grep target: `jscalendar::` references inside the workspace outside of `crate-jmap-calendars-types/` and `crate-jmap-jscalendar-types/`.

## Acceptance

- `cargo check -p jmap-calendars-types --all-features` clean.
- `cargo test -p jmap-calendars-types --all-features` clean.
- `cargo clippy -p jmap-calendars-types --all-features -- -D warnings` clean.
- `cargo doc -p jmap-calendars-types --all-features --no-deps` clean.
- `cargo test --workspace` clean — downstream crates (jmap-calendars-server, jmap-calendars-client, jmap-server, etc.) compile and pass without changes.
- `cargo tree -p jmap-calendars-types | grep jmap-jscalendar-types` shows the new dep.
- `crate-jmap-calendars-types/src/jscalendar.rs` is gone.
- `git diff --stat` shows net negative LOC (file removed, deps line added, lib.rs edited).

## Risk: implicit consumers

If any code outside calendars-types referenced `jmap_calendars_types::jscalendar::*` directly (rather than the top-level re-exports), they break unless we add `pub use jmap_jscalendar_types as jscalendar;` to lib.rs. Grep workspace-wide for `jscalendar::` before merging and either:
- Add the module alias re-export (preserves the nested path), OR
- Update those consumers to use the top-level re-export.

Recommendation: add the module alias for safety; it costs nothing.
title: Migrate jmap-calendars-types to consume jmap-jscalendar-types (path-dep + re-export)
